decks.title: Algorithms I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Analyze specifications, invariants, correctness proofs, asymptotic bounds, divide-and-conquer methods, and foundational search and graph algorithms.

decks.title: Analytical Chemistry
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Develop quantitative chemical analysis through sampling, calibration, uncertainty, method validation, separations, spectroscopy, and electrochemical measurement.

decks.title: Applied Statistics I
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Build practical inference skills with estimands, sampling distributions, standard errors, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, effect sizes, and bootstrap methods.

decks.title: Applied Statistics II
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Extend statistical modeling through multiple regression, generalized linear models, diagnostics, robust uncertainty, interactions, prediction, and multiplicity control.

decks.title: Bayesian Inference
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Connect priors, likelihoods, posteriors, predictive distributions, hierarchical models, computation, diagnostics, and Bayesian decision-making.

decks.title: Behavioral and Experimental Economics
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Study bounded rationality, reference dependence, heuristics, social preferences, experimental identification, treatment effects, and behavioral welfare analysis.

decks.title: Biochemistry
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Trace how molecular structure, noncovalent forces, enzymes, bioenergetics, signaling, and major metabolic pathways govern cellular chemistry.

decks.title: Biology I
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Establish the foundations of cells, heredity, evolution, homeostasis, energy flow, and scientific reasoning from experiments and biological evidence.

decks.title: Biology II
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Compare organismal diversity, phylogeny, plant and animal form, reproduction, physiology, behavior, ecology, and the history of life.

decks.title: Calculus I
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Learn limits, continuity, derivatives, applications of differentiation, definite integrals, and the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

decks.title: Calculus II
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Advance through integration techniques, improper integrals, sequences and series, Taylor approximation, and parametric and polar calculus.

decks.title: Causal Inference
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Reason from potential outcomes and causal graphs through confounding control, adjustment, instrumental variables, mediation, and bounded causal claims.

decks.title: Cell Biology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Examine membranes, organelles, trafficking, cytoskeleton, signaling, gene regulation, cell division, death, and experimental methods for studying cells.

decks.title: Chemistry Laboratory and Measurement
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Practice measurement design, uncertainty, calibration, solution preparation, separations, instrumental analysis, laboratory safety, and defensible reporting.

decks.title: College Algebra and Precalculus
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Strengthen algebraic fluency with equations, inequalities, functions, polynomials, rational expressions, exponentials, logarithms, and trigonometry.

decks.title: Computer Networks
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Follow data across layered networks through addressing, switching, routing, transport, congestion, naming, web protocols, security, and performance measurement.

decks.title: Computer Systems
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Connect bits and machine representation to C execution, memory, assembly, linking, processes, virtual memory, concurrency, and system interfaces.

decks.title: Data Structures
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Design and analyze abstract data types, arrays, linked structures, stacks, queues, hash tables, trees, heaps, graphs, and their invariants and costs.

decks.title: Data Systems
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Build reliable data products using contracts, schemas, change capture, batch and stream processing, storage layers, orchestration, quality, and observability.

decks.title: Databases I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Model relational data and write correct SQL while studying normalization, constraints, transactions, indexes, query plans, concurrency, and recovery.

decks.title: Discrete Mathematics
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Develop finite mathematical reasoning through logic, counting, recurrences, relations, graphs, trees, matchings, colorings, and combinatorial proofs.

decks.title: Ecology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Analyze populations, communities, species interactions, energy flow, nutrient cycles, ecosystem change, biodiversity, and conservation decisions.

decks.title: Econometrics I
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Learn regression-based empirical analysis through identification, OLS assumptions, inference, functional form, heteroskedasticity, endogeneity, and introductory causal designs.

decks.title: Econometrics II
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Advance to moment-based estimation, GMM, maximum likelihood, asymptotics, instrumental variables, panel methods, and robust specification testing.

decks.title: Economic Foundations
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Use scarcity, incentives, marginal reasoning, supply and demand, elasticity, market structure, policy, and macroeconomic measures to interpret economic choices.

decks.title: Electricity and Magnetism I
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Study electric and magnetic fields, Gauss’s law, potential, capacitance, circuits, induction, Maxwell’s equations, and electromagnetic waves.

decks.title: Evolutionary Biology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Explain evolutionary change with population genetics, selection, drift, gene flow, adaptation, speciation, phylogeny, and evidence from living and fossil systems.

decks.title: Experimental Design
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Plan credible experiments by defining units and estimands, randomizing, blocking, using factorial designs, controlling multiplicity, and preserving protocol integrity.

decks.title: Experimental Physics and Measurement
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Turn physical measurements into defensible results through calibration, uncertainty budgets, fitting, residual analysis, instrument limits, and reproducibility.

decks.title: General Chemistry I
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Build chemical foundations from matter and measurement through stoichiometry, atomic structure, periodic trends, bonding, molecular geometry, and gases.

decks.title: General Chemistry II
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Study thermodynamics, intermolecular forces, solutions, kinetics, equilibrium, acids and bases, solubility, electrochemistry, and phase behavior.

decks.title: Genetics
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Connect DNA and chromosomes to Mendelian inheritance, linkage, recombination, mutation, gene expression, pedigrees, quantitative traits, and population variation.

decks.title: Immunology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Follow innate and adaptive defense through recognition, inflammation, complement, antigen presentation, lymphocyte activation, antibodies, tolerance, and immune memory.

decks.title: Inorganic Chemistry
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Relate periodic structure and bonding to coordination complexes, crystal and ligand fields, magnetism, spectroscopy, redox chemistry, organometallics, and catalysis.

decks.title: Linear Algebra I
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Move from linear systems and matrices to vector spaces, linear maps, determinants, eigenvalues, diagonalization, orthogonality, and least squares.

decks.title: Linear Algebra II
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Study quotient and dual spaces, invariant subspaces, canonical forms, inner-product operators, spectral theory, bilinear forms, and advanced structure theorems.

decks.title: Macroeconomic Theory I
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Connect national accounting, labor markets, money, inflation, growth, saving, business cycles, and fiscal and monetary policy in core macroeconomic models.

decks.title: Macroeconomic Theory II
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Analyze dynamic economies with Euler and Bellman equations, Ramsey growth, recursive equilibrium, asset pricing, business cycles, policy rules, and open-economy dynamics.

decks.title: Mathematical Methods for Economics
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Apply functions, multivariable calculus, matrices, constrained optimization, comparative statics, difference equations, and dynamic systems to economic models.

decks.title: Mathematical Methods for Physics I
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Use vectors, matrices, complex numbers, vector calculus, Fourier methods, differential equations, and coordinate systems to formulate physical problems.

decks.title: Introduction to Mathematical Proofs
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Learn to read and write proofs using logic, quantifiers, sets, functions, relations, induction, contradiction, equivalence, and careful theorem structure.

decks.title: Mathematical Statistics
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Develop probability-based statistical theory through likelihood, sufficiency, completeness, estimation, hypothesis testing, information bounds, and asymptotic arguments.

decks.title: Mechanics I
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Model motion with vectors, kinematics, Newton’s laws, common forces, work and energy, momentum, collisions, center of mass, and introductory rotation.

decks.title: Mechanics II
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Extend mechanics through rigid-body motion, noninertial frames, central forces, oscillations, constraints, Lagrangian and Hamiltonian methods, and conservation laws.

decks.title: Microbiology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Study microbial cell structure, metabolism, growth, genetics, viruses, host interactions, pathogenesis, antimicrobial control, ecology, and laboratory evidence.

decks.title: Microeconomic Theory I
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Derive consumer and producer choice, duality, demand, cost, competitive equilibrium, welfare results, and market behavior from preferences and technology.

decks.title: Microeconomic Theory II
decks.subject: Economics
decks.description: Study choice under uncertainty, strategic games, repeated interaction, asymmetric information, contracts, mechanism design, and market failures.

decks.title: Modern Physics
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Explore special relativity, quantum states and measurement, atomic structure, statistical quantum ideas, nuclear physics, particles, and modern experimental evidence.

decks.title: Molecular Biology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Trace genetic information through DNA structure, replication, repair, transcription, RNA processing, translation, regulation, genomes, and molecular tools.

decks.title: Multivariable Calculus
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Work with vectors and surfaces, partial and directional derivatives, multiple integrals, coordinate changes, vector fields, and the major integral theorems.

decks.title: Numerical Analysis
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Understand error and conditioning while learning numerical methods for roots, interpolation, quadrature, linear systems, differential equations, and stability.

decks.title: Optics
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Connect ray and wave descriptions of light through reflection, refraction, mirrors, lenses, interference, diffraction, polarization, imaging, and optical instruments.

decks.title: Optimization I
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Formulate and solve optimization problems using convexity, existence conditions, duality, KKT theory, gradient methods, proximal methods, and solution certificates.

decks.title: Ordinary Differential Equations
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Solve and interpret first- and higher-order differential equations, linear systems, phase portraits, stability, transforms, series methods, and numerical approximations.

decks.title: Organic Chemistry I
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Reason from molecular structure through resonance, acidity, stereochemistry, conformations, substitution, elimination, and foundational alkene and alkyne reactions.

decks.title: Organic Chemistry II
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Use spectroscopy and mechanism to study aromatic, carbonyl, enolate, amine, carbohydrate, polymer, and multistep synthesis chemistry.

decks.title: Organic Chemistry Laboratory
decks.subject: Chemistry
decks.description: Plan, execute, and evaluate organic experiments using stoichiometry, extraction, distillation, crystallization, chromatography, spectroscopy, safety, and green metrics.

decks.title: Physics Foundations
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Build a quantitative base in units, vectors, kinematics, forces, energy, momentum, rotation, gravitation, fluids, thermal physics, waves, and circuits.

decks.title: Physiology
decks.subject: Biology
decks.description: Connect homeostasis and cellular transport to nervous, endocrine, muscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, digestive, and reproductive function.

decks.title: Probability Theory I
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Develop probability from sample spaces and counting through conditioning, independence, random variables, distributions, expectation, transforms, and limit laws.

decks.title: Probability Theory II
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Advance to measure-based probability, modes of convergence, conditional expectation, martingales, stochastic processes, laws of large numbers, and weak convergence.

decks.title: Programming I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Learn Python execution through values, expressions, control flow, functions, collections, files, exceptions, modules, testing, debugging, and small-program design.

decks.title: Programming II
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Build larger Python systems with modules, object-oriented design, typing, protocols, iterators, concurrency, performance, packaging, and stable API contracts.

decks.title: Real Analysis I
decks.subject: Mathematics
decks.description: Develop rigorous arguments about the real numbers, sequences, series, continuity, differentiation, compactness, uniform convergence, and Riemann integration.
topic_anchors: Cauchy sequence criterion in the reals

decks.title: Sampling and Survey Methods
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Design and analyze surveys using frames, inclusion probabilities, weights, stratification, clustering, ratio estimation, nonresponse adjustment, and variance estimation.

decks.title: Security Engineering I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Reason about threats, trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, cryptography, secure design, software and network attacks, privacy, and assurance evidence.

decks.title: Software Architecture
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Shape systems around quality attributes, workload and context models, components, interfaces, architectural views, tradeoffs, decisions, and evolutionary constraints.

decks.title: Software Engineering I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Practice evidence-driven software work across requirements, repository state, design, implementation, review, testing, CI, release, maintenance, and incident learning.

decks.title: Software Testing I
decks.subject: Computer Science and Software
decks.description: Design trustworthy tests with explicit behavior boundaries, oracles, equivalence classes, fixtures, coverage, property checks, mutation analysis, and verification evidence.

decks.title: Thermodynamics
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Relate equilibrium states and processes through the laws of thermodynamics, entropy, energy potentials, engines, phase behavior, mixtures, and statistical foundations.

decks.title: Time Series Analysis
decks.subject: Statistics
decks.description: Model serial data using stationarity, autocorrelation, ARIMA methods, forecasting diagnostics, volatility, state-space models, and frequency-domain ideas.

decks.title: Waves and Oscillations
decks.subject: Physics
decks.description: Study simple, damped, driven, and coupled oscillators before developing wave equations, normal modes, strings, sound, interference, dispersion, and energy transport.
